# Dr. Divya's Phoenix Dental Care

> Dental clinic in Chitlapakkam, Chennai, led by Dr. Divya S, BDS, MDS (Pediatric and Preventive Dentistry). Gentle dental care for children and adults.

## Clinic details

- Address: No 58/60, Ground Floor, Anna Street, Chitlapakkam, Chennai 600064, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90032 26380
- Email: phoenixdentalc@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM; Sunday by appointment only
- Website: https://drdivyaphoenixdental.com/

## Doctor

- Dr. Divya S, BDS, MDS (Pediatric and Preventive Dentistry)
- Associate Professor in a dental college
- Adult and child dental surgeon; consultant paediatric dentist
